newsitem.title: USA: Earthlink corrects Q1 share loss.
newsitem.headline: Earthlink corrects Q1 share loss.

text.p: EarthLink Network Inc said it was correcting its first quarter earnings report, to reflect a loss in the quarter of $0.92 per share, instead of the $0.79 loss originally reported.

In a statement issued late Friday, the company said the previously announced loss was based on fully diluted shares outstanding, using the treasury stock method, which is not applicable when a loss is reported for the period.
The company said the change in its per share loss does not affect its actual loss in dollars or its revenues.
